culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kaoru Taiyama. She tied a fishing line around the victim's neck and his Porsche seat then attached it to her car's gear lever. With the power-window she could make the line taut and strangle the victim. She recovers the line using the rear end wheels of a model toy car. Megure questions him not hearing any sound but the toy car's batteries which run around 10 minutes should have already expired.
